account_id.description: The unique identifier of the investor account.

limit.description: Number of items to return per response (pagination). Default is 10, maximum is 100.

offset.description: Number of items to skip in the response (pagination). Default is 0.

start_date.description: Start date for the range of trades (must be less than 180 days).

end_date.description: End date for the range of trades (must be less than 180 days).
